description: Experimental lookup of one name across MORVS's local public-record indexes; availability is not guaranteed. Returns per-dataset match counts and an indicative 0-100 score (risk_score) summarizing how many indexed records matched. The score is not a risk rating or compliance determination, and a low score or non-match is not clearance. Coverage and freshness vary by dataset.
